info.title: Quill client API
info.description:
The JSON-over-HTTPS API every Quill client uses (protocol draft, section 7). Federation between servers uses ActivityPub instead.

Authenticated operations take `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from `POST /auth/register` or `POST /auth/login`. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`). Every request body is size-checked before it is parsed: JSON bodies against the instance's `limits.maxEnvelopeBytes`, MLS objects inside them against `limits.maxMessageBytes`, blobs against `limits.maxAttachmentBytes` and backup parts against 8 MiB (`GET /instance` publishes the limits). Lists that page take `limit` and a cursor (`before`, `after` or `cursor`, as each operation says).

Privacy: sign-in fails the same way, in the same time, whether or not the login exists; a requester can't tell a held, pending, declined or expired request apart; and nothing a writer writes in a session reaches the server except as MLS ciphertext.

list is at `GET /admin/log/{id}`.

exists.description: Still on the server (visible or not).

whose one prompt is the entry's own.

bodyHtml.description: Sanitized HTML rendered by the server from `body`.

sticky.description:

token.description:

reported comment stays as it was reported; the author can delete it.

identities are personas.

saving it.

personal device group).

devices.
A device's KeyPackage pool ran low.
Notices were missed (the client fell behind): sync everything.
